note: Found by I14 in the 1,000-document mixed run (9 documents, every one a block link holding a right-to-left or CJK text with lineHeight 1 or 1.2). Reduced form: a CJK text in a PdfLink, lineHeight 1; the baseline is 1.3 pt below the link rectangle. Noto Sans Arabic (ascent about 1.37 em) at 10 pt and lineHeight 1 puts it 3.7 pt below. Likely cause: textkit places the first baseline at the line top plus the font ascent and ignores the half-leading that CSS gives, so a font whose ascent exceeds the line height draws below its box. Helvetica (ascent 0.718 em) never shows it. Fixed: a line puts half of what its line height adds to each run's glyph box above the glyphs (CSS half-leading, metrics.ts baselineOf), so the baseline lies (line height + ascent - |descent|) / 2 below the line top: inside the box whenever the line height is at least ascent - |descent| (about 0.87 em for this CJK face). Rows: test/paint-paths.test.ts, 'paints a line with ... at its half-leading'.
